turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Leo! Happy Saturday. How is your weekend in Austin starting off? Got any plans for rock climbing or playing guitar today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! It's going well. No rock climbing today, my forearms are still pretty sore. I did play some guitar this morning though. I made a matcha latte and just relaxed with it for a bit.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A matcha latte and guitar sounds like a perfect, cozy start to the weekend. Is Sam around today, or do you have the place to yourself?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sam's out running some errands, so it's quiet here. I actually just got ready for the day. I threw on a button-down shirt because I have a quick catch-up call with a logistics client in a bit.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Ah, even on a Saturday! I hope the call goes quickly. Do you have any plans for lunch after you wrap that up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, I'm going to keep it simple. I think I'll walk down the block and grab a deli sandwich.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sounds perfect. Do they have some good vegetarian options there?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: They do, they make a really good roasted veggie and hummus one that I love. It's my go-to.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds delicious! By the way, how is your running going? Have you been doing much since you completed the half marathon?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've been going on some light jogs, but nothing close to the half marathon distance. It's nice to run without the pressure of training.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Absolutely, keeping it fun is key. Have you caught up with your sister Ana lately? How are things going with her since the wedding in San Antonio?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually called Ana yesterday. She's doing really well, just busy. We were laughing about some of the memories from the wedding.
